about-studio.description: An outdoor view of several works set against a bright white wall under a clear blue sky, with palm trees behind and a green lawn in front. Two tall, pale, textured upright forms frame the group, and one of them holds a single block of saturated yellow. The scene is calm and sunlit, with strong shadows across the grass.
about-studio.altText: Several textured artworks on a white wall in a sunny garden, with two tall pale pillars framing the group and a bright yellow square on the right.

abstract-1.description: A dense charcoal mass rises along the right edge and pulls against a field of pale sand and off-white on the left. The surface is broken and layered, with scraped passages, dark specks and worn patches where the top layers have been pulled back. Heavy and quiet, the composition holds its weight at the lower edge.
abstract-1.altText: Abstract surface with a dark charcoal mass on the right and pale sand and off-white on the left, broken and textured.

abstract-10.description: A warm umber and grey field, mottled and softly layered, lightens toward the top into a hazy cloud. A dark vertical line runs down the right side, and a deep band along the bottom meets the field at a thin line of amber light. The surface is worn and uneven, with scraped marks and small pale flecks.
abstract-10.altText: Mottled brown and grey abstract field, lighter haze at the top, a dark band along the bottom edge with a thin line of amber light.

abstract-11.description: A pale, misty upper field fades into a dark, broken lower band of charcoal and blue-grey. In the centre, a soft grey shape with a few flecks of red-orange rises out of the haze, half lost in the light. The surface is scraped and layered, with the darkest marks gathered along the bottom edge.
abstract-11.altText: Pale misty abstract with a dark textured band across the bottom and a faint grey shape with touches of red-orange at the centre.

abstract-12.description: Two upright fields sit side by side, each divided into a bright, heavily textured upper area and a cooler blue-grey lower area. The surface is broken into crusted ridges and pale hollows, with a faint diagonal ridge crossing the right field. A soft shadow falls across the left field, so the two read as one horizon.
abstract-12.altText: Two upright abstract fields side by side, pale textured tops fading to cool blue-grey lower areas, with a soft shadow across the left one.

abstract-2.description: Nine rectangular fields stand side by side in a grid, each carrying raised ridges, diagonal folds and shallow shadows. Pale grey and off-white dominate, with the edges between fields picked out in darker lines. The surface reads as a record of many small movements, held in an even, measured order.
abstract-2.altText: Nine-part grid of pale grey relief fields with raised ridges, diagonal folds and soft shadows.

abstract-3.description: A deep slate-blue field fills the upper part, darkening toward the top edge. A thin golden streak floats across the middle, its bright surface catching the light. Below, a pale, luminous band gives way to a dark horizon line at the base. The mood is night-sky and open, with a single point of warmth.
abstract-3.altText: Dark blue-grey abstract with a golden streak across the middle, a pale band near the bottom and a dark horizon.

abstract-4.description: A broad, pale upper field is softly textured, with faint cracks and a few warm, tan marks. Below it a narrow band of warm grey-brown runs across, and two dark horizontal bars sit at the base, divided by a raised ridge. The division between light and dark is sharp and horizontal, giving the work a steady, grounded presence.
abstract-4.altText: Pale textured upper field over a warm grey band and two dark horizontal bars divided by a raised ridge.

abstract-5.description: A soft grey field fills most of the work, marked with faint scratches and a worn, uneven texture. A small inset rectangle near the upper left holds a single dark tree-like form against a pale ground. A band of dark, ragged tone runs along the base, anchoring the composition.
abstract-5.altText: Soft grey textured abstract with a small inset rectangle showing a dark tree-like shape and a dark band along the bottom.

abstract-6.description: Grey and white layers are broken by ochre and yellow patches at the upper left, and a dark, rounded shape sits on the right. A soft green-grey area glows low in the centre, while the lower edges warm into brown. The surface is rough and scraped, with energy in the brushed marks and calm in the wide grey ground.
abstract-6.altText: Grey and white abstract with ochre and yellow patches at upper left, a dark rounded shape on the right and soft green-grey below.

abstract-7.description: A pale off-white field sweeps across the upper part, marked with faint brushed lines and soft warm stains. Below, a broad dark band shifts from charcoal to deep green, with a vertical trace of green near its upper edge. The meeting of pale and dark is clean and low, so the work reads as open sky above a dark ground.
abstract-7.altText: Pale off-white abstract over a dark charcoal and deep green band along the bottom.

abstract-7-b.description: A wide crop of a night-toned field: slate blue at the top gives way to a pale, luminous band of grey-white. Along the lower edge, a dark horizon is scratched with fine pale lines. The cropped format tightens the composition and pushes the light into a narrow, glowing strip.
abstract-7-b.altText: Wide view of a slate-blue abstract with a pale luminous band and a dark, lightly scratched horizon along the bottom.

abstract-8.description: Raised, irregular shapes cover the centre of the work, set in a sandy, pale surface that breaks open at the edges. Small specks of blue are scattered through the lower part, and a warm, ochre tone lingers at the top. The textured pattern reads as close and layered, like a surface seen up close.
abstract-8.altText: Close view of a pale, textured abstract with raised irregular shapes and small blue flecks.

abstract-9.description: A pale, luminous area glows at the upper centre and fades into warm brown toward the sides. Below, the surface drifts through soft grey into a band of golden light, then falls into deep charcoal at the base. The gradients are veiled and worn, giving the piece a hazy, early-light atmosphere.
abstract-9.altText: Hazy vertical abstract, pale at the top, warm brown at the sides, with a golden glow above a dark charcoal base.

available-3.description: A weathered, pale grey surface holds a recessed inset in its upper centre, where a dark, branching silhouette stands against a pale sky over a shadowed ground. Below, a dark band gives way to a strip of warm brown streaked with marks. The surface is pitted and rough, and the mood is quiet and still.
available-3.altText: Weathered grey surface with a recessed inset showing a dark branching silhouette against a pale sky, above a dark band and a warm brown strip.

available-4.description: A pale grey upper field, flecked and textured, opens into a band of soft peach light near the middle. A thin, broken seam of deep red-brown runs along the edge where the peach band meets a heavy, dark grey lower field. The overall mood is calm and quietly warm.
available-4.altText: Textured grey abstract with a glowing peach band across the middle and a dark grey lower area below a broken red-brown line.

available-5.description: A grey field, mottled and streaked with lighter marks, sits above a deep charcoal band that fills the lower part. The upper area fades from pale to smoky grey, and the lower band carries a faint sheen and scraped texture. The mood is still and cool.
available-5.altText: Grey abstract with a mottled, streaked upper area fading to smoky tones, over a deep charcoal band across the bottom.

available-6.description: A near-black upper field, softly worn and scratched, rests on a deeper black band along the bottom. A faint lighter haze crosses the top edge. Pale flecks show where the surface has been rubbed, and the overall mood is quiet and low in light.
available-6.altText: Near-black abstract with a worn upper area over a deeper black band along the bottom edge.

available-7.description: A creamy white field, softly mottled and cracked in patches toward the top, fades warm toward the horizon. A thin line of ochre light sits along the edge where the warm band meets a heavy dark grey base. The surface is fine and dry, quiet and luminous.
available-7.altText: Cream abstract with cracked texture in the upper area, a warm ochre glow at the horizon and a dark grey base across the bottom.

available-8.description: A grey-brown upper field, scraped and streaked with pale marks, deepens into a dark slate-grey lower area. Across the middle, a faint mauve-tinged band sits between the two tones, its edge broken and smoky. The surface is worn and scratched, moody and still.
available-8.altText: Grey-brown abstract with a scratched, streaked surface and a darker lower area divided by a faint smoky band.

commission-intro.description: A large horizontal work hangs above a low, weathered bench in a bright, quiet room. Its upper field is pale cream, with a thin warm ochre line near the middle, and its lower band is deep slate grey. An olive tree in a tall, rough vessel stands at the left, and soft light falls across the pale walls and warm floor.
commission-intro.altText: A wide horizontal artwork with a pale cream upper area and dark grey lower band, hung above a low bench beside an olive tree in a bright room.

figurative-1.description: An off-white field fills the picture, rough and worn across its whole surface. At its centre, an upright recessed form with a rounded top reads as a standing figure, worked in grey and darker tones with broken, crumbling texture. Faint warm streaks run down from the top edge, and the mood is quiet and solemn.
figurative-1.altText: Off-white textured abstract with an upright recessed grey form, rounded at the top, reading as a standing figure at the centre.

figurative-10.description: A head in profile rises from a mottled grey surface, its brow and nose sharply modelled. Dry, golden stalks spread from the crown and fan upward above it. The head rests on a dark, weathered base with a flat foot, and the composition feels still and contemplative.
figurative-10.altText: Head in profile with a mottled grey surface, topped by fanning dry golden stalks and set on a dark, weathered base.

figurative-11.description: A head-like form tilts forward, its surface mottled grey and brown with a warm patch near the top. It rests on a pale rectangular block, and a flat wedge juts out to one side, giving the shape an off-balance poise. The forms are blunt and worn, and the mood is restless.
figurative-11.altText: Mottled grey head-like form tilted on a pale rectangular block, with a flat wedge projecting to one side and a warm patch near the top.

figurative-12.description: A head in profile, with deep-set, narrowed eyes and closed lips, is shown in rust-brown and grey tones. Heavy ridges mark the brow and cheek, and the surface is pitted and worn. It sits on a dark, angular base, and the expression is calm and inward.
figurative-12.altText: Head in profile in rust-brown and grey tones, with narrowed eyes, closed lips and a pitted, ridged surface, set on a dark angular base.

figurative-2.description: A tall, narrow figure rises in relief from a pale, textured ground, its ridged surface catching the light along one edge. Above it the field is off-white and scored with soft strokes, with ochre runs down the left side. A band of charcoal grey sits low across the base, grounding the upright form in a quiet, austere composition.
figurative-2.altText: Pale, tall figure in raised relief against an off-white textured surface, with a dark grey band across the bottom.

figurative-3.description: A pale, upright figure is pressed into a rectangular field of cracked off-white surface. Its outline is soft and its interior broken into many small ridges. The lower third turns dark grey, with flecks of warm ochre along the edge, and the whole piece reads as calm and weathered.
figurative-3.altText: Upright rectangle with a pale upright figure in low relief on a cracked off-white surface; the lower part is dark grey with ochre flecks.

figurative-4.description: A close crop of brushed charcoal and white marks, with two eye-like hollows set high in the field. Dense, mottled strokes break across the middle, and lighter streaks rise through the centre. The features are suggested rather than stated, and the energy is restless and layered.
figurative-4.altText: Close view of charcoal and white brushed marks forming a face, with two eye-like hollows and dense, mottled strokes through the centre.

figurative-6.description: A face fills an oval field in dark grey, its surface ridged and flecked with pale specks. A scraped line marks the brow, and a lighter edge frames the head against the grey ground. The lower face sinks into shadow, and the surface feels worn and heavy.
figurative-6.altText: Dark grey oval face with a ridged, flecked surface and a lighter grey border, the lower features sunk in shadow.

figurative-7.description: A face is pressed into a grey-toned surface, its brow, eyes and downturned mouth drawn in raised, scored lines. Silver highlights catch the edges of the marks while the ground around them stays dark and even. The expression reads as stern and watchful.
figurative-7.altText: Grey-toned face with raised, scored lines for brow, eyes and mouth, set in a dark, even surface with silvery highlights.

figurative-8.description: A pale face rises in soft relief from an off-white field, its brow and heavy-lidded eyes softened by light grey shadow. The mouth is a single firm line, and the edges of the head dissolve into the surrounding surface. The overall tone is weary and quiet.
figurative-8.altText: Pale face in soft relief on an off-white textured surface, with grey shadows around the heavy-lidded eyes and a firm mouth line.

figurative-9.description: A tall figure stands in relief against a pale, weathered upper field, its body shaded in dark grey and marked with fine scratches. The lower band is near-black and meets the upright form in a sharp edge. Faint warm tones along the edges give the piece a sense of age.
figurative-9.altText: Tall, shaded figure in relief against a pale weathered field, with a near-black band across the bottom and fine scratch marks on the figure.

hero-macro-2.description: A tall, upright composition in pale grey and cream, with cool blue shadows drifting down the right side and a soft rust-brown glow on the left. The surface is worked with scraped marks and soft ridges, and a dark band settles along the bottom edge. The mood is hazy, open and quiet, like a horizon seen at dusk.
hero-macro-2.altText: A tall pale grey and cream artwork with soft blue shading at the sides, a rust-brown glow on the left and a dark band along the bottom.

hero-macro-3.description: A vertical work on a white wall, with a mottled grey field broken by pale, lifted patches. The tones soften into cream towards the lower middle, then stop at a heavy charcoal band along the base. A soft shadow falls along the right edge, giving the piece a quiet, weathered presence.
hero-macro-3.altText: A vertical grey artwork with pale mottled patches, fading to cream and ending in a dark charcoal band at the base, on a white wall.

hero-macro-6.description: A close, full-frame view of a textured surface in pale blue-grey and off-white. Fine cracks and scratched lines run through the upper field, and a patch of lighter haze floats in the middle. A dense charcoal band anchors the bottom edge, with a faint warm tint where the tones meet.
hero-macro-6.altText: A full-frame textured artwork in pale blue-grey and white, with fine cracks and a dark charcoal band along the bottom edge.

insitu-collection.description: A dining room with a long, rich-brown table and cream upholstered chairs on a grey rug. A horizontal work hangs above the table, grey and textured, with a pale band across its middle and a dark base. Through the glass doors at the right, a pool and greenery glow in soft daylight.
insitu-collection.altText: A dining room with a long brown table and cream chairs, under a grey horizontal artwork, with a pool visible through glass doors.

insitu-hospitality.description: A living room with a tall, pale work hung on a cream wall above a low shelf and a grey sofa. The work is cream and off-white, with a darker grey vertical form running down its centre, rough with ridged texture. Warm light falls through the side window onto a round, light-toned coffee table and a textured rug.
insitu-hospitality.altText: A living room with a tall cream artwork with a darker central form above a grey sofa, a low shelf and a light round coffee table.

insitu-lobby.description: Two works hang on a textured grey wall where a hard diagonal shadow cuts across the surface. On the left, a charcoal field sits above a darker lower band, with a small pale triangle of light at its foot. On the right, a pale grey work carries a small dark-edged inset with a bare tree and a deep base band.
insitu-lobby.altText: Two artworks on a grey wall in strong diagonal shadow: a dark charcoal work on the left and a pale work with a small tree inset on the right.

object-014.description: A dim lounge with a deep grey tufted sofa on the left and a long grey-toned sideboard beneath a dark work. The work has a glowing pale centre, a charcoal upper band and a warm brown lower band. A white-topped low table and dark upholstered chairs with slim warm-toned frames complete the calm, shadowed room.
object-014.altText: A dim lounge with a grey tufted sofa and a dark textured artwork with a pale glowing centre above a long sideboard.

process-01-material.description: A man in a blue shirt leans into a large grey work, pressing its upper edge against a bright white curved wall. The work shows a pale grey surface that darkens toward its lower edge and a deep black side. Beside him stand a tall olive tree and two large pale vessels on a glossy floor, all lit by strong sunlight.
process-01-material.altText: A man in a blue shirt presses a large grey artwork against a white curved wall, beside an olive tree and two pale tall vessels.

process-03-cast.description: A close view of a work filling the whole frame, with a soft grey upper field that warms to pale ochre near the horizon. A thin, bright amber seam runs across the middle, and the lower section is a deep charcoal field with faint streaks. The surface is calm and evenly lit, with a quiet sense of dusk.
process-03-cast.altText: A close view of an artwork with a soft grey upper field, a warm ochre glow, a thin bright amber line at the horizon and a dark charcoal base.

process-hero.description: A close, angled view of a textured surface in pale grey and sandy tones, with a smooth, reflective strip running along the top edge. A broken, bright amber seam crosses the lower middle, and beneath it the surface turns blue-grey with fine scraped grooves. The mood is tactile and raw, shown in close detail.
process-hero.altText: A close-up of a textured pale surface with a bright amber seam across its lower middle and a smooth reflective strip along the top edge.

process-hero-2.description: Three tall upright sections sit side by side against a dark ground. Their upper areas are pale, mottled grey and white, warming to rust and brown toward a thin, light horizon line. Below it the surface turns to deep charcoal.
process-hero-2.altText: Three tall upright sections side by side, pale grey and white above, dark charcoal below, with a light horizon line.

process-hero-b.description: A close corner view of a pale, mottled surface meeting a narrow grey edge along the left side. The texture is soft and uneven, with faint darker flecks and a gentle shadow where the surface turns back from the edge.
process-hero-b.altText: Close view of a pale, mottled grey surface with a narrow grey edge along its left side, lit softly.

ref-1.description: A tall, single surface with a pale grey and warm taupe upper area, softly worked and layered. Across the lower part a dark charcoal band sits under a thin line of warm brown, giving a quiet sense of a horizon. The texture is subtle, with fine marks visible across the light areas.
ref-1.altText: Tall pale grey and taupe surface, softened at the top, with a dark charcoal band across the bottom and a thin warm line above it.

ref-2.description: A close view of a single surface, mottled in warm beige and taupe with small darker flecks across it. A bright white band runs along the lower edge, its ragged top breaking into the warm ground above. The contrast is soft but clear, and the texture stays visible throughout.
ref-2.altText: Close view of a warm beige, mottled surface with a bright white band along the bottom edge, its top edge ragged.

ref-3.description: A square-format work with a deep charcoal field, edged in warm peach and pale grey. A pale head, softly modelled, rises from the dark centre with its eyes lowered. The word FOREVER is marked into the dark field at right, and the worked surface shows many small marks.
ref-3.altText: Square work with a pale head with lowered eyes rising from a dark field, edged in peach and grey, with the word FOREVER at right.

ref-4.description: A tall upright surface with a pale cream top that softens and drifts downward. A faint vertical shape stands near the centre of the light area. Below a soft horizon, olive, slate and gold tones run down in streaks, with bright light ridges between them.
ref-4.altText: Tall upright surface, pale cream above and olive, slate and gold streaks below a soft horizon.

ref-5.description: A tall upright surface of pale white, roughly worked, with a central grey-brown column-like form rising from a lower band. Small rust-coloured marks sit along the column's edges. The lower area breaks into mottled grey and white, and a dark edge runs along the bottom.
ref-5.altText: Pale, textured upright surface with a central grey column-like form, small rust marks, and mottled grey below.

ref-6.description: A tall, narrow upright work with a saturated red-orange ground. A pale grey figure stands in the centre, its head dark at one side and its long form ridged with worked lines. Dark charcoal marks shade the figure's left side and the outer edges.
ref-6.altText: Tall narrow work on a red-orange ground with a pale grey standing figure and dark shading at its left side.

ref-7.description: A tall upright work with a red-orange ground and a pale grey standing figure, lit by warm light from the upper left. The light picks out ochre and gold in the red and softens the dark marks on the figure's left side. Ridged texture runs down the figure's right side.
ref-7.altText: Tall red-orange work with a pale grey standing figure, lit warmly from the upper left.

sculptural-1.description: A pale grey upper field gives way to a dark slate lower band, with a small rectangular opening at left holding a dark tree silhouette against a warm, bright ground. The horizon is low and the composition is quiet and spare. The surface texture is soft and worn throughout.
sculptural-1.altText: Pale grey textured surface with a dark lower band and a small rectangular inset showing a dark tree silhouette on a warm, pale ground.

sculptural-11.description: A pale grey field is marked by a patch of cracked blue-grey at the left and a horizontal gold-toned bar across the centre. The lower section is a deep slate, dark and textured. The contrast of cool tones and the single bright line gives the work a precise, quiet focus.
sculptural-11.altText: Pale grey textured surface with a cracked blue patch at left, a gold-toned horizontal bar at centre and a dark slate lower band.

sculptural-2.description: A wide, horizontal landscape of misty cream and grey, with rust-brown banks rising at either side. A luminous pale band runs through the centre, reflecting light over a cool blue-grey base. The layers feel soft, hazy and open.
sculptural-2.altText: Wide horizontal view of a pale misty sky, rust-brown banks at each side, a glowing pale band across the centre and a cool blue-grey base.

sculptural-3.description: A tall, dark composition split by a warm horizontal bar. Above it, glowing ochre, cream and touches of blue suggest a dusky sky; below, a charcoal field is eroded into deep, textured ridges. The contrast between warmth and darkness is strong and atmospheric.
sculptural-3.altText: Tall dark composition with a glowing ochre and cream upper section, a warm horizontal bar at the centre and a textured charcoal lower field.

sculptural-4.description: A pale, textured upper field holds a recessed dark-grey opening, set above a band of slate-blue at the base. A thin warm strip runs along the lower edge. The arrangement is spare and geometric, with a sense of threshold and stillness.
sculptural-4.altText: Pale textured surface with a recessed dark rectangle, a slate-blue lower band and a thin warm strip along the bottom edge.

sculptural-5.description: A cream, weathered upper field holds a recessed rectangle in soft grey and warm beige. The lower ground shifts into sandy tones, with a rough, uneven surface. The mood is quiet, warm and worn.
sculptural-5.altText: Cream textured surface with a recessed rectangle in grey and beige, above a rough sandy lower band.

sculptural-6.description: A stark white upper field has a dark, recessed opening topped by a rust-orange edge and scattered faint blue marks. Below, a charcoal band runs the full width. The cracked, layered surface gives the piece a sharp contrast of light and dark.
sculptural-6.altText: Stark white textured surface with a dark recessed rectangle topped by a rust-orange edge, above a charcoal lower band.

sculptural-7.description: A pale, creamy field fades softly into a grey lower area, where a horizontal band of charcoal is warmed by faint rust tones. The surface shows gentle wear and scattered grey patches. The composition reads as a low horizon at dusk.
sculptural-7.altText: Pale cream textured surface with grey patches, a soft grey lower area and a dark band near the bottom with faint rust tones.

sculptural-8.description: A wide, pale grey field is crossed by a single dark horizontal line. A small rectangle left of centre holds a warm sepia scene of a lone tree on a rise. The surface is textured and softly weathered, with calm, open space around the inset.
sculptural-8.altText: Wide pale grey textured field with a dark horizontal line and a small warm sepia inset showing a lone tree.

sculptural-9.description: A tall, pale cream surface is heavily textured, with soft shifting light near the centre. Near the bottom, a warm amber glow sits above a deep charcoal base. The effect is atmospheric and luminous, like a sky at the edge of night.
sculptural-9.altText: Tall cream textured surface with a soft glow near the lower centre above a dark charcoal base.

show-hero-2.description: An outdoor show with white display walls under trees and a row of tents. Several paintings hang on the walls, mostly pale grey and warm taupe with dark bands along their lower edges. Visitors walk past on the pavement, and a folding chair sits at the front of one booth.
show-hero-2.altText: Outdoor art show with white display walls, pale grey and taupe paintings with dark lower bands, and visitors walking past.

shows-1.description: A corner of an outdoor show, with white display walls and paintings hung at several heights. The largest work is pale grey and white above a warm brown and dark lower edge. Smaller works show dark charcoal and a muted green band, and a brick building and green tree stand behind the booth.
shows-1.altText: Outdoor booth with white walls and paintings in pale grey, warm brown and charcoal, with a green tree and brick building behind.

thumb-009.description: A small, close view of a single surface. Its upper area is pale grey, mottled and textured, with a faint warm line near the lower edge. A broad charcoal band sits across the bottom and meets the lighter area softly.
thumb-009.altText: Small view of a mottled pale grey surface with a dark charcoal band across the bottom and a faint warm line above it.

thumb-021.description: A tall, pale work with a mottled, creamy surface that deepens to grey and warm gold toward the lower half. A dark band sits along its lower edge. The image is small, so the finer texture is hard to make out.
thumb-021.altText: Tall pale mottled work with warm gold and grey tones and a dark lower edge.
